meta.description: Bends paths with smooth noise, more toward the tip. Every segment keeps its length, the same seed gives the same bend.

plant.description: The paths to bend. Only the deepest level bends (see depth), the others are passed on.

scale.description: How fine the noise is: a path of length L gets about L × scale / 10 bends, so at 20 a stem of 0.5 m bends once and at 80 four times.

strength.description: How far the noise bends a path. The bend grows with strength over the length of the path: on a path of 0.5 m, 0.02 bends it gently and 0.1 curls it, a path ten times as long needs ten times the strength.

depth.description: On which layers of paths to work, counted from the deepest. 1 bends only the deepest paths, higher values reach down to the trunk. Paths always follow the paths they grow on, also on layers that are not bent.
